hints.title: Symmetric Pair Mismatch Count
hints.text: Count how many symmetric pairs s[i] and s[n - 1 - i] differ across the first half of the string.

hints.title: Mismatch Operations Budget
hints.text: Changing one character in a mismatched pair fixes that position in one operation.

hints.title: Allowable Mismatches
hints.text: If there are at most 2 mismatches, you can make the string a palindrome using one or two operations.

hints.title: Opposite Pointer Mismatch Counter Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Generating all strings with 1 or 2 character edits takes O(26^2 * n) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Two pointers inspect symmetric indices using constant memory.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Identifies that each mismatched symmetric pair requires exactly one replacement.
